subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should doctor --fix be allowed to delete a persisted plugin install record when its primary install/source path is missing?
rationale: The code path is narrow and proven, but deleting installRecords is an intentional compatibility-sensitive state repair that maintainers should explicitly accept before merge.

options.title: Accept the doctor state repair
options.body: Merge this PR with the current primary-path rule because it matches discovery precedence and the PR now includes scratch CLI proof.

options.title: Constrain the removal rule
options.body: Ask for a narrower predicate if maintainers only want this to remove records for specific managed/runtime plugin families.

options.title: Pause for broader upgrade proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a packaged upgrade scenario reproduces the exact missing-path state and shows the repair end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor state repair
recommendation.body: Merge this PR with the current primary-path rule because it matches discovery precedence and the PR now includes scratch CLI proof.
